notes.title: Updated March 18, 2025
notes.content:
Stage tuning patches have been applied to address looseness in general stage progression.
We've evened out the distance between normal stages and bosses, making it a little less tiring to reach them.

However, this patch also adjusted the save for progress already achieved.
As a result, some players may need to restart their progress on the changed stages after the update.
We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to provide a better gaming experience.

Added a stage progress UI.
You can now see your current progress when you first start a stage.

Fixed a bug that was discovered.
